items.text: Guwahati is the Gateway to the Northeast - the first real stop for students and professionals from Assam, Meghalaya, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, Tripura, Arunachal Pradesh, and Sikkim, long before any decision about Delhi, Bangalore, or another metro comes up.
Good counselling here is not about deciding for or against the whole Northeast in the abstract.
